title: Greek Aesthetics Bodybuilding Program (Apollonian Physique Workout)
summary: NH presents a free 4-day Apollonian program, the counterpart to his Farnese Hercules program, aimed at a golden-ratio V-taper physique like Greek statues but slightly more muscular. It uses supersets plus nucleus overload for lats, shoulders and abs, smaller emphasis on legs and arms, and mostly 3-set compound-plus-isolation blocks for late novices and early intermediates.
claims: The Apollonian program is a counterpart to the Farnese Hercules program, for lifters wanting a slimmer, conventionally aesthetic physique
Aesthetic physiques approximate the golden ratio; many people think modern bodybuilders look bad because proportions abandoned it
Aim for something slightly bigger than the statue of David, which lacks muscularity
Apollonian means a V-taper (wide shoulders and lats, small waist, tight core); Farnese Hercules is an X-taper with big legs, core and arms
A small waist is mostly genetic bone structure; NH was born with a big waist
Heavy knee flexion and hip hinge work develops the waist, so don't overdo it if you want a tight waist, but a few sets of squats won't bloat you; pro bodybuilders' bellies come from drugs
Big-waisted lifters should build their obliques anyway because it looks better
Nucleus overload is used for lats, shoulders and abs, the three areas that create the V-taper
Lat nucleus overload: pullovers (mandatory for rib cage expansion and V-taper), light pulldowns or pull-ups, grease the groove
Shoulder nucleus overload: face pulls or lateral raises, never overhead pressing; face pulls offset the shoulder stress of pullovers
Ab nucleus overload: any ab exercise or stomach vacuums; vacuums may help keep the waist slim, though they're useless for NH's own shape
Train four days, e.g. 2 on 1 off or 2 on 2 off; don't do four in a row or recovery may suffer
Upper day: bench/dips/weighted push-ups 3x6-10 + DB rows 3x8-12 or inverted rows AMRAP; OHP 4x6-12 + abs + French press/skull-crushers 4x8-12 + hammer curls 4x6-10 + lats
Resting five minutes after bench is wasted time; even strength work can be supersetted, e.g. bench with rows
Supersetting a triceps long-head exercise after a press barely hurts performance, at worst one rep lost; he tested it
If you can't superset in a commercial gym, split the exercises
The upper day's five-exercise giant set is hard on cardio; the whole session should take no more than about 1.5 h with rests
This is a late novice to early intermediate program; Farnese Hercules is late intermediate to early advanced
Use upper/lower and arm/upper hybrids rather than two lower days because classical statues have smaller legs and arms
Upper/lower hybrid: deadlift 3x3 / RDL 3x8-12 / good morning 3x6-12 + seated calf raises 3x15-20; weighted pull-ups 4x4-8 + lunges or Bulgarian split squats 4x10-15 + shrugs 4x12-15 + shoulders
Calves must match the rest of the physique for golden-ratio proportions
Include at least one heavy vertical pull; use lat pulldowns if you can't do weighted pull-ups
Lifters with naturally big traps can skip shrugs; Greek statues don't have huge traps
Arms/upper hybrid: close-grip bench 3x6-10 or diamond push-ups + seal or Pendlay rows 3x8-12 + lats; curls 3x6-8 + upright rows or laterals 3x12-15 + abs + triceps pushdowns 3x15-20
Mostly 3 sets per exercise: for this physique goal doability matters more than intensity, so be conservative
Upright rows bias traps; lateral raises bias side delts
Lower day once per 7 days: squat 3x6-10 / leg press 3x8-12 / hack squat 3x10-12 + seated calves; hyperextensions or single-leg DB RDL 4x12-15 + decline crunches + neck curls + shoulders
Hack squat is for those who don't want squat technicality; leg press for those with lower back problems
Some waist thickening is fine if lats and shoulders grow with it: be a capital V, not a lowercase v
Don't starve yourself to look like a statue; eat enough without overdoing it
The hamstring slot can be glute-ham raises, Nordic curls or machine leg curls
Train neck at least once a week for injury prevention (e.g. car crashes) and some size
Run the program 6 to 18 months, then move to a bigger program if you want more mass
